common: Use case: ui-mockup. This is a preview-only concept edit of the supplied actual Chinese game screenshot, Deep Surge nautical survival card game. Keep the exact 1280x720 composition, three columns, all Chinese text, numbers, resource illustrations, panels, margins, typography and readability. Change the BUTTON ARTWORK only, including tabs, +/−, target choice buttons, primary action, secondary action and close X. Create a purposeful button family with different silhouettes and visual weights by role, not the same frame on everything. Primary is strong, secondary is restrained, selected is unmistakable, disabled is quiet. Avoid repeated compass medallions, clutter, oversized ornaments and glowing sci-fi HUD. Maintain generous text-safe centers and practical touch targets. Keep X a clean centered sans-serif diagonal cross. Do not add explanatory text, watermark, headings, labels or extra UI. Final image must look like a polished game UI screenshot with these proposed button assets.

variants.A: ART DIRECTION A — maritime brass / deep enamel. Handcrafted satin antique brass edges with tiny rivets only on primary buttons, dense midnight-blue enamel centers, subtle beveled relief and almost no texture. Main action has a restrained clipped-corner rectangular brass rim and warm ivory text; secondary actions are slim navy inset plates with only a thin brass top edge; tabs are small copper index tabs with selected amber underline; quantity controls are square brass-framed slate chips. Ornamental language is aged nautical instrumentation, sophisticated and tactile, not ornate fantasy. Preserve all source words.
variants.B: ART DIRECTION B — sea-glass / tidal jade. Elegant translucent smoked teal glass, thin desaturated seafoam borders, gentle watery light along one edge. Primary is a smooth pill with a small pearl-white point of light on the left and deep teal luminous center; secondary actions are near-flat dark teal outlined lozenges with no decorations. Tabs have a continuous subtle wave underline only for selected. Quantity controls are soft rounded glass squares; disabled controls are frosted low contrast. Calm oceanic, contemporary fantasy, compact and refined; absolutely no high-tech HUD or neon. Preserve all source words.
variants.C: ART DIRECTION C — navigator parchment / ink and sealing wax. Warm ivory parchment action buttons with crisp deep ink lettering and small folded-cut corners; only the main action has a narrow tarnished-gold frame and a tiny flat oxblood sealing-wax accent near one end, never obscuring text. Secondary buttons are dark navy plain ink-outline labels on thin parchment tabs with less visual weight; selected resource choices get a warm ivory inset and ink text. Quantity controls are small cream paper squares, disabled are cool gray parchment. Tiny chart-line flourishes only at the ends of the main action. Sophisticated nautical journal style with very restrained paper grain. Contrast warm buttons against the unchanged navy panels. Preserve all source words.
